# Database Performance Monitoring

This runbook covers systematic approaches to monitoring and optimizing database performance in production environments.

## Key Performance Indicators
- Query execution time
- CPU and memory usage
- I/O throughput
- Connection pool utilization
- Lock contention metrics

## Monitoring Tools
- pg_stat_statements for PostgreSQL
- Performance Schema for MySQL
- Custom monitoring dashboards
- Application performance monitoring (APM) tools

## Optimization Strategies
Systematic approach to identifying and resolving performance bottlenecks.
